premise: Astronaut throws a pebble for Robo-dog; in the low gravity it floats up so slowly that Robo-dog sits up and waits… and waits — and Geologist decides science needs more throws.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Dog and the Shadow', turned: the dog waits patiently for the real thing, and the waiting becomes the game.
lesson: Patience can be the best part of the fun.
learning: Things fall slowly on the Moon: its gravity is much weaker than the Earth's.

en-US.title: The Pebble That Took Its Time
en-US.text: {robodog:enter} Robo-dog wanted to play. He trotted over to {astronaut:enter} Astronaut, wagging his antenna tail. {astronaut:face happy} Fetch? said Astronaut. She scooped up a grey pebble and {astronaut:live hold} tossed it up… and up… and up. On the Moon, gravity is gentle, and things fall very, very slowly. {robodog:live hold} {sfx:whirr} Robo-dog sat up to wait. And waited. The pebble hung above them like a lazy little moon. {geologist:enter} Geologist came loping over. {geologist:face surprised} [gasps] Careful! Nobody has studied that rock yet! Down, down it drifted, {astronaut:live resume} into Astronaut's glove — and she tossed it to Geologist. {geologist:live} He tapped it with his hammer and peered at it through his round glasses. {geologist:face sad} [sighs] Hmm. Perfectly ordinary. Then his eyes lit up. {geologist:face happy} [excited] Throw it again! Science needs more tries! {robodog:live resume} {robodog:face happy} {astronaut:face happy} So they played the slowest game of fetch in the solar system, {all:hop} all afternoon.

es-ES.title: El guijarro sin prisa
es-ES.text: {robodog:enter} Perro robot quería jugar. Fue trotando hasta {astronaut:enter} Astronauta, moviendo su cola de antena. {astronaut:face happy} ¿Jugamos? dijo ella. Cogió un guijarro gris y {astronaut:live hold} lo lanzó hacia arriba… y arriba… y arriba. En la Luna la gravedad es suave, y las cosas caen muy, muy despacio. {robodog:live hold} {sfx:whirr} Perro robot se sentó a esperar. Y esperó. El guijarro flotaba sobre ellos como una lunita perezosa. {geologist:enter} Geólogo llegó dando zancadas. {geologist:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Cuidado! ¡Esa roca no la ha estudiado nadie! Bajó flotando, despacito, {astronaut:live resume} hasta el guante de Astronauta… y ella se la lanzó a Geólogo. {geologist:live} Él la golpeó con su martillo y la miró de cerca con sus gafas. {geologist:face sad} [sighs] Mmm. Una piedra normal. Pero entonces le brillaron los ojos. {geologist:face happy} [excited] ¡Otra vez! ¡La ciencia necesita más pruebas! {robodog:live resume} {robodog:face happy} {astronaut:face happy} Y jugaron al juego de lanzar y traer más lento del sistema solar, {all:hop} toda la tarde.

whirr.prompt: a small robot dog's servo motors whirring as it sits up, short and cute
